steps.name: walk the stepper
steps.expr: const out=[]; for(let n=0;n<4;n++){ document.querySelectorAll('#step-bar button')[n].click(); out.push(n+':'+document.getElementById('step-out').textContent.length);} const s=document.getElementById('step-q'); s.value=String(25); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); document.getElementById('step-next').click(); document.getElementById('step-next').click(); document.getElementById('step-next').click(); return out.join(' ')+' | N6 answer: '+document.getElementById('step-out').textContent.slice(-160)

steps.name: click reveals
steps.expr: ['bet-k','bet-tok','bet-hyde','bet-rerank','bet-idk','bet-th','bet-crag','bet-proxy','bet-thg','bet-judge'].forEach(id=>{const b=document.querySelector('#'+id+' button[data-opt]'); if(b) b.click();}); ['btn-k','btn-tok','btn-rrf','btn-hyde','btn-rerank','btn-idk','btn-th','btn-crag','btn-proxy','btn-thg','btn-para','btn-board','btn-judge'].forEach(id=>{const b=document.getElementById(id); if(b) b.click();}); return ['k-note','tok-note','hyde-note','rerank-note','idk-note','th-note','crag-note','proxy-note','thg-note','para-note','board-note','judge-note'].map(id=>id+': '+document.getElementById(id).textContent.slice(0,170)).join(' || ')

steps.name: free text and selfquery
steps.expr: const f=document.getElementById('ar-free'); f.value='Mamba-2 SSD'; f.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter'})); const a=document.querySelector('#arena .rl').textContent.slice(0,120); document.querySelectorAll('#sq-presets button')[1].click(); return a+' || '+document.getElementById('sq-filter').textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ')+' || '+document.querySelectorAll('#sq-cols .rl')[1].textContent.slice(0,120)

steps.name: states
steps.expr: ['ps-mode','data-tabs'].forEach(id=>{const b=document.querySelectorAll('#'+id+' button'); b[b.length-1].click(); b[0].click();}); const r=document.getElementById('rr-k'); r.value='50'; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.querySelector('#mk-list [data-dn]').click(); return document.getElementById('rerank-note').textContent.slice(0,200)+' || '+document.getElementById('mk-out').textContent.slice(0,160)

steps.name: selfquery songs
steps.expr: const out=[]; document.querySelectorAll('#sqs-presets button').forEach(b=>{b.click(); out.push(b.textContent+' → '+document.getElementById('sqs-note').textContent.slice(0,90)+' | top: '+(document.querySelector('#sqs-cols > div:nth-child(2) .r .x b')||{textContent:'—'}).textContent);}); return document.getElementById('sq-gonzo-note').textContent.slice(0,120)+' || '+out.join(' || ')

steps.name: threshold groups
steps.expr: const bs=document.querySelectorAll('#thg-groups button'); bs[0].click(); bs[1].click(); const t=document.getElementById('thg-t'); t.value='0.55'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const a=document.getElementById('thg-stats').textContent; bs[2].click(); const b=document.getElementById('thg-stats').textContent; bs[2].click(); return a+' || other encoder: '+b+' || '+document.getElementById('thg-note').textContent

steps.name: proxy slider
steps.expr: const t=document.getElementById('px-t'); const out=[]; for(const v of ['80','60','45','40']){ t.value=v; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); out.push(v+': '+document.getElementById('px-stats').textContent);} t.value='80'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.querySelector('#px-plot circle').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return out.join(' | ')+' || '+document.getElementById('proxy-note').textContent

steps.name: kappa
steps.expr: const s=document.getElementById('ks-sh'); const out=[]; for(const v of ['0','1','2']){ s.value=v; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); out.push(v+': '+document.getElementById('ks-stats').textContent);} s.value='1'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return out.join(' | ')+' || '+document.getElementById('ks-check').textContent

steps.name: flare
steps.expr: const t=document.getElementById('fl-t'); t.value='0.4'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.getElementById('fl-run').click(); return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(document.getElementById('fl-stats').textContent+' || '+document.getElementById('fl-log').textContent.slice(0,240)),16000))

steps.name: svg text clipping
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((s,si)=>{ const vb=s.viewBox.baseVal; if(!vb||!vb.width) return; s.querySelectorAll('text').forEach(t=>{ if(t.getAttribute('transform')) return; let b; try{b=t.getBBox();}catch(e){return;} if(b.width===0) return; if(b.x<-1||b.y<-1||b.x+b.width>vb.width+1||b.y+b.height>vb.height+1) bad.push((s.closest('[id]')||{id:'svg'+si}).id+': "'+t.textContent.slice(0,30)+'" '+Math.round(b.x)+','+Math.round(b.y)+' '+Math.round(b.width)+'x'+Math.round(b.height)+' in '+vb.width+'x'+vb.height); }); }); return bad.length? bad.slice(0,25).join(' | ') : 'no clipped text'

steps.name: horizontal overflow
steps.expr: const w=document.documentElement.clientWidth; const bad=[...document.querySelectorAll('.panel, .ragfig, .prose')].filter(n=>n.scrollWidth>n.clientWidth+2 && !n.closest('.scroll-x')).map(n=>(n.id||n.className)+':'+n.scrollWidth+'>'+n.clientWidth); return bad.length? bad.slice(0,10).join(' | '):'none'
